name: Compliance Versus Control Mismatch
anti_triggers: control boundary fully aligned and documented
single actor captures and controls the dominant variable
physical_basis: Regulatory or filing pressure attaches to a physical system boundary, but the actor facing the pressure may not control the dominant operational variable.
operational_basis: Schedules, charging, tenant behavior or process control can sit outside the party carrying the visible compliance burden.
financial_mechanism: Compliance pressure can be translated into the wrong retrofit or underwriting logic if control and capture boundaries are misread.
typical_false_assumption: The actor facing compliance pressure can automatically capture the value of the required action.
hypothesis: Compliance burden may be real while the relevant control boundary remains unresolved, making straightforward owner-side value claims inadmissible.
rival_hypotheses: the same actor controls and captures the dominant variable
compliance burden is minor relative to operational control
boundary and metering are already well aligned
minimum_evidence_to_confirm: control or capture boundary remains misaligned
falsification_conditions: single actor clearly controls and captures the dominant variable
allowed_claim_language: Compliance pressure may be real while control and capture boundaries remain too unresolved for owner-capture claims.
prohibited_claim_language: The owner will capture the compliance-driven savings.
financial_exposure_if_false: attention can shift to other dominant constraints
stop_conditions: control and capture boundary are bounded enough to rank compliance-driven action
escalation_conditions: operator or owner-side lease confirmation required when public evidence remains insufficient
example_outputs: The compliance burden may be real even when the owner does not yet control the dominant efficiency lever.
tests: building and leased-asset bundles should admit this when compliance pressure and control-boundary ambiguity coexist
pattern must not become local capture truth without case evidence
